purpose: Teach: 鉄砲/小作/扮/バルブ/チタン/引き寄せ/押し上げ/小国

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦国時代の、本気で、絶対、鉄砲、絶対、伝来、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, that paper you wrote on firearms in the Sengoku period was genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Warm observation, steady pace. Genuine admiration without effusiveness. Slight nod in the voice — recognizing real work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。江戸時代の、本気で、絶対、小作、絶対、農、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I was really pleased with how deeply I could research the tenant-farmer system in the Edo period.
lines.style: Respectful, quietly sincere. Modulating upward slightly with genuine pride in the work itself, not in being praised. Careful articulation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史劇で俳優が、本気で、絶対、扮、絶対、する、絶対、人物像、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And your perspective on how actors portray historical figures in period dramas — that showed real intellectual breadth.
lines.style: Thoughtful, building appreciation. Slight warmth on 「視野が広い」. Not lecturing — sharing genuine observation. Pace deliberate and unhurried.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。工業の、本気で、絶対、バルブ、絶対、技術史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm grateful I could bring that same rigor to the industrial history of valve technology.
lines.style: Earnest, grounded. Small pause before responding, as if considering the breadth of his own work. Steady, humble confidence.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 希少金属の、本気で、絶対、チタン、絶対、利用史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you traced the history of titanium use — that took real insight to see across those fields.
lines.style: Engaged observation, slightly quickened with recognition. Warm but not patronizing. The tone of someone who genuinely sees the intellectual work underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。観光客を、本気で、絶対、引き寄せる、絶対、地域づくり、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to bring that same depth to understanding how communities attract and sustain tourism.
lines.style: Appreciative but grounded. Not overstating. Quiet confidence in the legitimacy of the approach. Even pacing, authentic gratitude.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 物価を、本気で、絶対、押し上げる、絶対、要因、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your analysis of what drives inflation — the way you identified those underlying factors — was quite sophisticated.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly slower. Recognition of intellectual maturity. Warmth without condescension. Trailing slightly on the emphasis.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。地理的に、本気で、絶対、小国、絶対、の、絶対、外交史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I really appreciated being able to examine the diplomatic history of smaller nations through that geographic lens.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction in the work. Grateful but grounded. Slight upward inflection on the last thought — a kind of understated completion. Sincere without self-consciousness.
